purpose.en: Explore acceptable sharpness, circle of confusion, viewing conditions, and distance.
purpose.zh-cn: 了解可接受清晰度、容许弥散圆、观看条件与距离。

editorialNote.en: Depth-of-field comparisons need stated viewing and framing conditions; background blur is not the same metric.
editorialNote.zh-cn: 景深比较需声明观看与取景条件，背景虚化不是同一测量。

verification.evidence: The tutorial defines acceptable focus and explains viewing criteria and aperture/distance variables.
